classification.difficultyReason: Translate the given speed and goalpost coordinates into component equations, apply the taught elimination method, and solve a quadratic for two launch angles.

content.prompt: Cooper kicks a football at $12\text{ m s}^{-1}$ and just clears a goalpost 4 m high and 9 m away. Find the two possible angles of projection to the nearest degree.

answer.worked:
Using $g=10\text{ m s}^{-2}$,
$$\begin{aligned}x&=12t\cos\theta\\y&=12t\sin\theta-5t^2.\end{aligned}$$
Substitute $(x,y)=(9,4)$:
$$\begin{aligned}9&=12t\cos\theta\qquad(1)\\4&=12t\sin\theta-5t^2\qquad(2).\end{aligned}$$
From (1),
$$t=\frac{3}{4\cos\theta}.$$
Substitute into (2):
$$\begin{aligned}12\sin\theta\left(\frac{3}{4\cos\theta}\right)-5\left(\frac{3}{4\cos\theta}\right)^2&=4\\9\tan\theta-\frac{45}{16\cos^2\theta}&=4.\end{aligned}$$
Using $\sec^2\theta=1+\tan^2\theta$,
$$\begin{aligned}9\tan\theta-\frac{45}{16}(1+\tan^2\theta)&=4\\45\tan^2\theta-144\tan\theta+109&=0\\\tan\theta&=\frac{144\pm\sqrt{144^2-4(45)(109)}}{90}\\\tan\theta&=\frac{144\pm6\sqrt{31}}{90}\\\theta&\approx51^\circ\text{ or }63^\circ\quad\text{(nearest degree).}\end{aligned}$$
